findings.body: The result-accumulation link, like most source links in this note, points into the author's absolute `/Users/.../Workdir/myclaw/` checkout. Readers on GitHub or another checkout cannot follow these references to verify the research or implement the planned stories. The cited implementation exists at `apps/core/src/jobs/ipc-delegated-agent-execution.ts:109`, which I read and which contains the described assignment. Replace checkout-specific source links with repository-relative links.
findings.title: Use repository-relative links for the research evidence

why: Subagents refuse, hang, lose results and ignore job and permission rules
